div.div: Why per partition and not global. The first version took a single global maximum. During a forty-minute catch-up the six partitions drifted apart and 169,000 perfectly normal events were marked 'too late'. Per-partition watermarks — what Flink does too — fixed that.

div.div: Why an idle partition does not count. Without an idle timeout a single silent partition holds the watermark back forever and no window ever closes again. After 120 s of silence a partition stops counting, until it sends something again.

text.tspan: Why an idle partition does not count. Without an idle timeout a single silent partition holds the watermark back forever and no window
ever closes again. After 120 s of silence a partition stops counting, until it sends something again.

div.div: And if the whole country goes quiet. Between 01:00 and 05:00 there are twenty to thirty night buses running. After 90 s without events the processor advances the watermark on the wall clock, so the last window of the night still closes.

text.tspan: And if the whole country goes quiet. Between 01:00 and 05:00 there are twenty to thirty night buses running. After 90 s without
